name: optcatalog_reflect_and_sort_impact_trace_list
description: OptCatalog::ReflectAndSortImpactTraceList chooses a trail direction toward the farthest target, projects targets along that direction, and sorts the target list by projection.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this helper; tier S verification is deferred to the OptCatalog/zWeapon runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b0ca0 validates ECX as OptCatalogTrailRuntimeState*, EDX as targetProjectionScratch, stack directionOut, target count from runtime offset 0x144, target list from offset 0x148, origin position from offset 0x20, farthest target selection using zMath::Vec3DeltaLength, direction output via zMath::Vec3DirectionTo, per-target dot projection into scratch storage, and bubble-sort swaps of both target slots and projection values.
The native smoke verifies farthest-target direction selection, ascending projection order, and paired target-position/velocity slot swaps.
